title: Svartlebee's Woundseeker

sources.title: Deepen the Wound
markers: | description = The wielder gains a +1d4 bonus to {{Attack Roll}}s with this weapon when attacking creatures that have already taken damage.

summary: +1 greatsword grants an attack bonus against injured creatures.

fields.Weapon profile: Martial, Two-handed, 5 ft melee, Heavy, Dippable. 2d6 + 1 Slashing plus Strength. +1 to attack rolls.
fields.Deepen the Wound: +1d4 to attacks with this weapon against creatures that have already taken damage.
fields.Acquisition: Disarm Gauntlet Yeva at Waukeen’s Rest before leaving the area, or acquire it in the Act Two Tadpoling Centre.
fields.Cleave: With proficiency, once per Short Rest. Action in a 7-ft cone, up to 3 non-allied creatures or objects. Each takes half weapon damage, with flat bonuses unhalved.
fields.Lacerate: With proficiency, once per Short Rest. Action, weapon damage. CON save against weapon-action DC +2 or Bleeding for 2 turns, with 2 Slashing at turn start and Disadvantage on CON saves until healed. The condition source lists Constructs, Elementals, Plants, Oozes and most Undead as immune, with Ghasts and Ghouls as exceptions.
fields.Pommel Strike: With proficiency, once per Short Rest. Bonus Action for 1d4 nonlethal Bludgeoning. CON save against weapon-action DC +2 or Dazed for 2 turns, losing Dexterity AC bonus and Reaction use and gaining Disadvantage on WIS saves. Help clears it.

changes: Added reviewed native BG3 gameplay and exact item and dependency citations. Reconciled applicable action, condition, and variant details against pinned rules.
